tools_helpful.evidence: Migration produced a clean x64 Debug build (BUILD SUCCEEDED, only CS8618 nullable warnings) with the scaffold + mapping workflow.
Process-alive gate passed; app registered and launched. It could not, however, detect that the window rendered blank.

tools_problematic.problem: Proves only that the process stays alive; a fully blank (unpainted) window passes green.
tools_problematic.evidence: Build+smoke were green yet the scored parity capture is a blank white window (notes/winui-live-recheck.png).

tool_limitations.limitation: The migration agent cannot see the rendered window, so a blank-render regression is invisible to it and it declares done on a green build.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Give the validator a static signal for the most common blank-render cause (scaffold system backdrop) so the agent is warned without needing to see pixels.

special_apis.special_handling: Scaffolded by 'dotnet new winui' into MainWindow.xaml. Requires DWM composition; in headless/VM/RDP capture environments the backdrop fails to present and the ENTIRE window renders blank white even though the visual tree is populated and hit-testable. UWP originals had no backdrop (opaque page). Remove the <Window.SystemBackdrop> for reliable rendering + faithful parity.

errors_encountered.error: Migrated WinUI 3 window renders completely blank white; nav pane, title, description, and Choose file button do not paint though they exist in the UIA/visual tree.
errors_encountered.root_cause: MainWindow.xaml (from the 'dotnet new winui' scaffold) declares <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/></Window.SystemBackdrop>. The system backdrop cannot composite in the automated/VM parity-capture environment, so the whole window fails to present. An opaque page background (ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush was already set) does NOT rescue it — the backdrop itself must be removed.
errors_encountered.fix: Delete the <Window.SystemBackdrop> block from MainWindow.xaml (leave a normal opaque window/page background). App then renders identically everywhere, matching the opaque UWP original.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent shipped an app that renders blank white in the capture environment.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a — not detected; build + smoke launch were green so the agent stopped.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The blank-render cause (scaffold MicaBackdrop not compositing in headless/VM capture) is not covered by the skill and not detectable by the process-alive smoke gate, and the migration agent cannot screenshot.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved in-trial; surfaced only by the independent parity capture.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A validator WARN that flags a <Window.SystemBackdrop> in MainWindow.xaml + a MIGRATION-PATTERNS anchor documenting the blank-window-despite-populated-tree mechanism and the remove-the-backdrop fix.

missing_tooling.need: Static detection of the scaffold system backdrop as a blank-render risk.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The single decisive FAIL — a blank window scored 0/1.

env_issues.issue: Parity screenshots are captured in an automated/VM/headless context where Mica/Acrylic system backdrops do not composite.
env_issues.workaround: Do not rely on a system backdrop for content visibility; ship an opaque window/page background (matches the opaque UWP original).
